title: Set identification color for unarchived records
goal: Use :not() to exclude elements in a specified state.
summary: The current exhibition label uses dark green, and the archived exhibition label retains the original text color. Text in other categories also retains the default color.
tasks: sets color: #125a46 to all elements with an .entry class and without an .archived class.
Preserves the color of archived records and external prompts.

example.note: This rule selects a elements that do not have an external class.

hint: Write the class selector to be excluded in :not() brackets, and then connect it to .entry.
